name: assembly-newsh2-119
summary: A dug-in ground bunker on a dirt tile: a dark grey armoured carapace, rounded at the back (top of the screen) and splitting into two pointed prongs at the front, with a tan stepped pyramid roof on its middle whose wide base ends in two wing tips, two pipe legs a side running from the carapace down into the dirt, a tan spike between the prongs and a long cast shadow to the lower right. Hard surface: plated armour with crisp chamfered edges and seams, flat faces on the pyramid; the legs are round pipes.

concept.use: design guide; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours

traits: tan pyramid with its point at the back (row 13) and its wide base along rows 27-28 from column 5 to 35
the tallest part of the structure, clearly standing above the carapace
flat crisp faces meeting in sharp ridges; the centre ridge from the point to the peak catches the light
a step (ledge) part way down, as in the concept's stepped roof
the base corners stick out past the carapace as wing tips
features.note: Sprite: lit left face, dark right face; that is the game's light, not paint, so all faces share one tan.

traits: dark grey armoured shell about 21 px wide, round at the back
raised with a flat top and chamfered shoulders, not a thin slab
seams split it into plates: a raised centre band between grooves at columns 17 and 24
features.note: The concept shows riveted plates with an outer rim; the sprite's light streaks on the left are edges catching the light.

traits: grey plated rail running forward from the carapace (columns 10-17)
front end chamfered to a point on the outside
about as tall as the carapace's front, with crisp edges
mirror of the left prong (columns 23-29)
its back half lies in the pyramid's cast shadow in the sprite
features.note: Same shape as the left prong.

traits: two tan round pipes of constant diameter running diagonally from the carapace's side down into the dirt
parallel, about 5 px apart
features.note: The concept draws them as pipes with elbows and flanged feet.

traits: mirror of the left legs
round pipes reaching into the dirt
thin tan rod or spike under the pyramid's front, between the prongs, pointing forward
tapers to a point at row 35
features.note: The concept reads it as a faceted drill-like spike.

traits: near-black shadow on the dirt to the lower right of the structure
features.note: Painted on the ground: the game draws no cast shadows.

traits: brown dirt filling the tile, with light pebbles
features.note: Ground tile; stays low so neighbouring tiles meet.
